brief.goal: Implement spec/phase12/authenticated-web-session-lifecycle.md IL1-IL8 as the next complete authenticated user-to-orchestrator vertical. Add injected-provider HTTPS login/bootstrap, atomic durable credential/CSRF rotation, refresh and logout routes for cookie and Bearer sessions, exact Origin/TLS/content-type/body controls, strict credential response posture, fail-closed ordering/audit, restart-safe old-token refusal, and live stream revocation without any coordinator fleet side effect. Start with red tests and preserve all command/SSE behavior.
constraints: Edit only: impl/src/web-auth.mjs, impl/src/web-northbound.mjs, impl/src/index.mjs, impl/test/phase12-web-auth.test.mjs, impl/test/phase12-web-northbound.test.mjs, impl/test/phase12-web-stream.test.mjs, impl/test/phase12-web-session-lifecycle.test.mjs.
Use Node built-ins only; no new dependencies.
Baton is not an identity provider: request JSON may not choose user/capability/repository claims.
Rotation must be one durable session-store event that installs the successor and revokes the predecessor before returning credentials.
Do not put raw token, CSRF, login credential body, or provider secret in session/coordination events, errors, URLs, or callback metadata.
Cookie refresh/logout require current cookie authentication plus exact session CSRF.
No auth lifecycle route may call a coordinator fleet method or stop work.
Preserve WN6 live expiry/revocation checks so old principals close after rotate/logout.
Do not add OIDC redirect details, rate limiting, trusted-proxy behavior, WebSocket parity, UI, or homelab integration in this vertical.
Do not commit, push, or use network tools.
Ground every behavior in IL1-IL8 and preserve existing tests.
brief.definitionOfDone: Red-first tests prove provider-only claims, cookie and Bearer login/rotate/logout, atomic restart-safe refusal of old credentials, TLS/origin/CSRF/body bounds, append/audit failure, non-leakage, stream liveness revocation, and zero fleet calls

payload.text: The current store supports issuance/revocation but has no atomic rotation event, and the HTTP authority has no lifecycle routes yet. I’m adding rotation as a single persisted event that applies successor installation and predecessor revocation together; lifecycle auditing will be separate and fail closed without ever invoking coordinator methods.

payload.text:
Implemented the authenticated web session lifecycle vertical.

Key additions:

- Provider-injected login claims only.
- HTTPS, exact Origin, JSON, and bounded-body enforcement.
- Cookie and Bearer login, refresh, and logout.
- Atomic durable `session.rotated` events.
- Restart-safe predecessor-token refusal.
- Strict Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite cookie handling.
- Cookie-bound CSRF validation.
- Fail-closed session append and coordination audit behavior.
- Existing stream liveness revocation preserved.
- No lifecycle coordinator fleet calls.
- Added lifecycle rotation, persistence, non-leakage, and append-failure tests.

Verification passed exactly as requested:

```text
pass 37
fail 0
exit code 0
```

No commit, push, network access, or out-of-scope file edits were performed.
